note: v0, written by hand after reading single-feature SB agreement on practice (not fitted). One net for all classes. score = deg + dualm + 0.5 obj + 0.7 ps + 0.3 frac - 3 relu(0.4 - frac). deg captures hub variables whose up-branch propagates widely (indset); dualm/obj capture how much the LP pays for the column (setcover; for basic columns dualm == |c_j|); ps keeps SCIP's running evidence; the ReLU gate kills nearly integral candidates (argmin-frac agreement was 0%). Features are >= 0, so relu(x) = x passes them through the first layer.
